correctness.rationale: All energy shells t=0 through 2N occur. It suffices to compare adjacent shells, because minimum population in the lower shell exceeding or equaling maximum population in the next propagates by transitivity. For two such words, twice minus the log population ratio is u+v+(u-v) times the difference in middle-level counts, with the intended grouping (u+v)+(u-v)*Delta. The difference is odd and lies between -r_N and r_N. Both extremes occur: compare the r_N ones against the endpoint-only words at energies r_N-1 and r_N+1; append the same zero for even N. Thus the sharp inequality is u+v>=r_N|u-v|, with equality passive by rearrangement. Rearranging gives the sandwich. The least allowed odd r_N strictly exceeding 2 max(u,v)/|u-v|-1 gives the floor formula including integer-ratio boundaries; equal slopes give Gibbs and no activation. Independent replay: python3 -I -B /workspace/audit_replays/frozen_math.py 5, with 12240 exact adjacent-shell checks up to 15 copies for ordered positive integer triples bounded by 16.
residual_risks: The test is for arbitrary joint cyclic unitaries and exact equidistance with positive populations. Neither the proof nor replay determines optimal work yield or a rank-deficient classification.
